# AmigoXcel

> AmigoXcel is a growth partner bringing together talent, technology, training and creative media so businesses can build faster, scale smarter and stand out globally.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Services across talent and recruitment, web and app development, training programs, and video and creative media, plus a free strategy call booking form.
- [Resume Tailor](/resume-tailor): Free tool that scores a resume against a job description and builds a tailored resume to download.
